content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I am considering using the [product_name] [article_no] module. Is it possible to connect some inputs with AC and others with DC 24V? For example, i1 as 24V AC and i2 as 24V DC. Thank you for your assistance.
This forum is focused on [product_name]. I'm unfamiliar with the [product_name] 24AC7DC module.
Hello [user_name], I believe the user is referring to a [product_name] module with 24V AC and 7 / DC specifications.

[user_name], regarding the [product_name] [article_no]: I highly recommend reading the manual ([document]) for guidance when connecting the [product_name]. The wiring diagram included shows grouping requirements, and mixing phases is permitted if inputs are grouped in sets of 4 as indicated. However, mixing AC and DC voltages on the input side is not possible. The reference pin is either AC or DC, so connected sensors must match the [product_name]'s supply voltage. Since the outputs use relays, you can freely mix voltages for outputs as the relay connections are not internally linked to a common point unlike the inputs. Does this clarify things?
Dear [user_name], thank you very much for your response. You’re correct—all inputs must use AC 24V. Mixing is not supported.

Alternatively, you can use all 24V DC inputs. The choice depends on your application, but I generally avoid AC for control voltage. Using a switch-mode 24V DC power supply offers short-circuit protection, provided the supply's capacity isn't oversized. Some power supplies also offer feedback signals. Fuses are an important safety feature to consider.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum members clarified that [product_name] [article_no] does not support mixing AC and DC voltages across input channels; all inputs within a group must use the same voltage type. The need to consult documentation for correct wiring implies some technical complexity, which may be challenging for less-experienced users. Users can mix voltages only on relay outputs, not on the inputs.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expected the option to mix AC and DC input voltages on the [product_name] [article_no] module and looked for clear instructions about proper wiring.
